query: What does the road sign indicating 'Road narrows on one side' signify?
reference_answer: It warns drivers that the road ahead will narrow on one side, requiring caution and potential adjustments in lane position.
context:
[Document 1]
It warns drivers that the road ahead will narrow on one side, requiring caution and potential adjustments in lane position.

[Document 2]
It indicates the centre line of a two-way road.

[Document 3]
Warning signs can indicate slippery roads, gated and ungated level crossings, uneven roads, road humps, steep upward and downward slopes, roads leading to quays, river banks, or seas.

[Document 4]
Merging arrows indicate that two traffic lanes are merging into one traffic lane and give motorists advance warning of this situation.

[Document 5]
It indicates that a motorist can drive on ahead.
answer: The sign signifies that the road ahead will narrow on one side, requiring drivers to be cautious and possibly adjust their lane position. [Document 1]
